external.title: How to re-create the missing "/etc/default/grub" file in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7?

entries.summary: Leapp detected "/etc/default/grub" does not exist. The file is essential for the in-place upgrade to finish successfully. This scenario might have occurred if the system was already upgraded from RHEL 6. Please re-create the file manually.
